yan5xu: 正好也分享一下关于上下文压缩这个事情

https://x.com/yan5xu/status/2032478407146311850

yan5xu
正好也分享一下关于上下文压缩这个事情。

我之前对上下文压缩这个事情也很头疼，尝试过各种压缩办法，摘要、滑动窗口等等，无论哪种总会发现后续工作会因为一些信息没了，不符合我的预期。

后来想明白了，是压缩就一定会丢失信息，所以解决上下文窗口有限的办法不是不存在的无损压缩，而是 agentic memory，给 agent 工具让它自己搜索和召回丢失的信息，压缩就不再是问题了。

这个想法是被 openclaw 启发的，它在对话历史上用了 RAG。我在这个基础上做了些改进：框架层对每个 query 自动做 embedding 召回相关 chunk，每个 chunk 又带 topic ID 和位置信息，agent 可以据此拉取前后上下文（也可以自己做语义搜索）。

实际感受，大部分时候自动召回大部分就足够了，不够的时候 agent 也会自己多搜几轮，最差的情况我记得，它第一次没搜出来的时候，我提醒一下它再搜，也能搜出来。

这个思路。。我在 epiral/Agent 的时候做了

@Noah ♥ 2 · 💬 0

实际体验下来还有一个发现：memory 不止是解决上下文窗口不够用的问题，更大的价值在于跨 session 的知识积累。agent 每次醒来都是白纸，但 memory 让它能记住上周的决策和教训。压缩解决的是单次对话的信息量，memory 解决的是 agent 的时间维度。

@BiteByte ♥ 0 · 💬 1

用个一年半载的，信息就爆炸了，这时怎么解决效率问题呢

@𝙩𝙮≃𝙛{𝕩}^A𝕀²·ℙarad𝕚g𝕞 ♥ 0 · 💬 0

compaction和compression有啥区别？

@Ne0@Digital ♥ 0 · 💬 0

说到点子上了。压缩本质是有损的，与其纠结怎么压得更好，不如让 agent 自己按需去检索。把记忆问题从压缩转成搜索，思路对了。

yan5xu: @TarunAmasa asked about context compression, sharing my approach here

https://x.com/yan5xu/status/2032477267973255591

yan5xu
@TarunAmasa
asked about context compression, sharing my approach here.

I struggled with this for a long time. Tried all kinds of compression — summaries, sliding windows, you name it. Every method had cases where lost information degraded downstream performance.

My takeaway: compression will always lose information. The real solution isn't better compression — it's agentic memory. Give the agent tools to search and recall what was lost, and compression stops being a problem.

This idea was inspired by openclaw @steipete
, which uses RAG over conversation history. I extended it further: every user query triggers automatic embedding search to recall relevant chunks, and each chunk carries metadata (topic ID + position) so the agent can pull surrounding context. The agent also has tools to do semantic search on its own.

In practice, auto-recall works well most of the time. When it doesn't, the agent searches a few more rounds. Worst case, I nudge it — "I remember we discussed this" — and it finds it. It always gets there.

Agentic memory > lossless compression.

热门回复

@Ne0@Digital ♥ 0 · 💬 0

Exactly right. Compression is fundamentally lossy — the question is always "lossy relative to what task?" Agentic retrieval sidesteps this entirely. With 1M context windows shipping today, the real bottleneck shifts from fitting tokens to knowing which ones matter.

@SWH | (168, 168) ♥ 0 · 💬 0

Thanks for sharing your take
